definition: a good reason for doing something
sentence: There is no {justification} for shouting at a waiter.
translation: Нет никакого оправдания для крика на официанта.

definition: to fall or let fall in small drops
sentence: The tap continues to {drip} all night and keeps me awake.
translation: Кран продолжает капать всю ночь и не даёт мне спать.

definition: to kill someone or something, used in stories or news
sentence: In the legend, the knight must {slay} the dragon to save the town.
translation: В легенде рыцарь должен убить дракона, чтобы спасти город.

definition: to decide not to continue with a plan, at least for now
sentence: The council decided to {shelve} the plan for the new bridge.
translation: Совет решил отложить план нового моста.

definition: to clean something thoroughly, especially skin or a wound
sentence: {Cleanse} the cut with warm water before you cover it.
translation: Промой порез тёплой водой, прежде чем закрыть его.

definition: the child of your son or daughter
sentence: Their first {grandchild} was born on New Year's Day.
translation: Их первый внук родился в Новый год.

definition: the act of making something new again or continuing an agreement
sentence: The {renewal} of my passport took three weeks.
translation: Продление паспорта заняло три недели.

definition: to take something important away from someone
sentence: The war will {deprive} a whole generation of its education.
translation: Война лишит целое поколение образования.

definition: a mass of small bubbles on a liquid, or a soft light material
sentence: The waves left white {foam} along the sand.
translation: Волны оставили белую пену на песке.

definition: a group of sheep, goats or birds
sentence: A {flock} of geese flew south over the lake.
translation: Стая гусей пролетела на юг над озером.

definition: a small bomb thrown by hand
sentence: The soldier pulled the pin and threw the {grenade}.
translation: Солдат выдернул чеку и бросил гранату.

definition: a person who helps an important person in their work
sentence: The senator's {aide} wrote most of the speech.
translation: Помощник сенатора написал большую часть речи.

definition: to make or become broader
sentence: The city plans to {widen} the road to four lanes.
translation: Город планирует расширить дорогу до четырёх полос.

definition: to open again after being closed
sentence: The museum will {reopen} in May after two years of repairs.
translation: Музей снова откроется в мае после двух лет ремонта.

definition: to become or make more serious, worse or more intense
sentence: The argument began to {escalate} when he raised his voice.
translation: Спор начал обостряться, когда он повысил голос.

definition: a woman who belongs to a religious community and lives apart from the world
sentence: The {nun} taught maths at the convent school for forty years.
translation: Монахиня сорок лет преподавала математику в монастырской школе.

definition: public support for someone or something, often from a famous person
sentence: The candidate won the {endorsement} of three major newspapers.
translation: Кандидат получил поддержку трёх крупных газет.

definition: a young unmarried woman, used in old stories
sentence: In the tale, a {maiden} waits in the tower for her rescuer.
translation: В сказке девушка ждёт в башне своего спасителя.

definition: an entrance that can be closed by a gate, or a way to reach something
sentence: The port is the {gateway} to the whole region.
translation: Порт — ворота во весь регион.

definition: to force someone to leave a school, organisation or country
sentence: The school decided to {expel} the boy for bringing a knife.
translation: Школа решила исключить мальчика за то, что он принёс нож.

definition: to control or limit something that is not wanted
sentence: The government is trying to {curb} the rise in rents.
translation: Правительство пытается сдержать рост арендной платы.

definition: to join pieces of metal by heating them until they melt together
sentence: The mechanic will {weld} the broken frame back together.
translation: Механик заварит сломанную раму.

definition: a thin layer of a substance that covers a surface
sentence: The pan has a {coating} that stops food from sticking.
translation: У сковороды покрытие, которое не даёт еде прилипать.

definition: using cruel words or violence towards someone
sentence: She left her {abusive} husband and moved to another city.
translation: Она ушла от жестокого мужа и переехала в другой город.

definition: the area behind a house, often with grass
sentence: The kids are playing football in the {backyard}.
translation: Дети играют в футбол на заднем дворе.

definition: in a way that covers a large area or many things
sentence: She has travelled {extensively} in South America.
translation: Она много путешествовала по Южной Америке.

definition: the part of your face above your eyes and below your hair
sentence: He wiped the sweat from his {forehead} with his sleeve.
translation: Он вытер пот со лба рукавом.

definition: the act of forgiving someone for something they did wrong
sentence: He asked his brother's {forgiveness} for the years of silence.
translation: Он попросил у брата прощения за годы молчания.

definition: in a way that breaks the law
sentence: The car was parked {illegally} outside the hospital entrance.
translation: Машина была незаконно припаркована у входа в больницу.

definition: relaxed and friendly, not following strict rules
sentence: The meeting was {informal}, so nobody wore a suit.
translation: Встреча была неформальной, поэтому никто не надел костюм.

definition: the state of being fully grown or behaving like a sensible adult
sentence: She showed great {maturity} in dealing with the bad news.
translation: Она проявила большую зрелость, столкнувшись с плохими новостями.

definition: expecting good things to happen
sentence: The coach is {optimistic} about the team's chances this season.
translation: Тренер с оптимизмом смотрит на шансы команды в этом сезоне.

definition: full of problems or difficult to deal with
sentence: Getting the piano up the stairs will be {problematic}.
translation: Поднять пианино по лестнице будет проблематично.

definition: intended to advertise a product or event
sentence: The shop gave away {promotional} bags with its name on them.
translation: Магазин раздавал рекламные пакеты со своим названием.

definition: likely to be or become something in the future
sentence: A {prospective} buyer came to look at the house twice.
translation: Потенциальный покупатель дважды приходил смотреть дом.

definition: relating to the treatment of mental illness
sentence: He spent two months in a {psychiatric} hospital after the breakdown.
translation: После нервного срыва он провёл два месяца в психиатрической больнице.

definition: things you throw away because they are no longer wanted, or nonsense
sentence: Put the {rubbish} out on Tuesday night for the morning collection.
translation: Выставь мусор во вторник вечером, чтобы утром его забрали.

definition: a long story about many years or events, or a long series of problems
sentence: The {saga} of the broken lift has gone on for six months.
translation: История со сломанным лифтом тянется уже полгода.

definition: the number 17
sentence: At {seventeen} he left home to work on a ship.
translation: В семнадцать он ушёл из дома работать на корабле.

definition: a soft silver-white metal that forms part of salt
sentence: Too much {sodium} in your food can raise your blood pressure.
translation: Избыток натрия в пище может повысить давление.

definition: done according to a fixed plan or method
sentence: The police made a {systematic} search of every house in the street.
translation: Полиция провела планомерный обыск каждого дома на улице.

definition: too bad to be allowed or agreed to
sentence: Being an hour late for work is {unacceptable}.
translation: Опаздывать на работу на час недопустимо.

definition: not knowing about something
sentence: She was {unaware} that the shop had already closed.
translation: Она не знала, что магазин уже закрылся.

definition: not happening or seen often
sentence: Snow is {uncommon} here, so the city has no snowploughs.
translation: Снег здесь редкость, поэтому в городе нет снегоуборочных машин.

definition: already started and happening
sentence: Work on the new school is {underway} and should finish by June.
translation: Строительство новой школы идёт и должно завершиться к июню.

definition: likely to change, fall or fail suddenly
sentence: The ladder is {unstable}, so ask someone to hold it.
translation: Лестница неустойчивая, попроси кого-нибудь её подержать.

definition: on or to a higher floor of a building
sentence: The bathroom is {upstairs}, the first door on the left.
translation: Ванная наверху, первая дверь слева.

definition: not clear or exact, hard to understand
sentence: He gave a {vague} answer about when he'd be back.
translation: Он уклончиво ответил, когда вернётся.

definition: using careful examination of facts and details to understand something
sentence: Her {analytic} mind made her a good detective.
translation: Её аналитический ум сделал её хорошим детективом.

definition: a short written message from one person to others in an office
sentence: The manager sent a {memo} about the new parking rules.
translation: Менеджер разослал служебную записку о новых правилах парковки.

definition: something you cannot see or remember clearly
sentence: The last hour of the party is a {blur} to me.
translation: Последний час вечеринки я помню смутно.

definition: to shine light on something, or to make it clear and easier to understand
sentence: Candles {illuminate} the church during the evening service.
translation: Свечи освещают церковь во время вечерней службы.

definition: to set a machine or system back to its starting state
sentence: Hold the button for ten seconds to {reset} the router.
translation: Удерживай кнопку десять секунд, чтобы перезагрузить роутер.

definition: a long box in which a dead body is buried or burned
sentence: Six men carried the {coffin} out of the church.
translation: Шестеро мужчин вынесли гроб из церкви.

definition: a person who makes films, especially a director
sentence: The young {filmmaker} shot her first film on a phone.
translation: Молодой режиссёр сняла свой первый фильм на телефон.

definition: a long formal dress, or a loose piece of clothing worn in hospital
sentence: She wore a silk {gown} to the award ceremony.
translation: На церемонию награждения она надела шёлковое платье.

definition: an outdoor area where children can play, often with swings and slides
sentence: The {playground} behind the school has a new climbing frame.
translation: На игровой площадке за школой новая лазалка.

definition: a short phrase that is easy to remember, used in advertising or politics
sentence: The {slogan} on the poster was just three words long.
translation: Лозунг на плакате состоял всего из трёх слов.

definition: a hard swelling on the body, or a solid piece of something
sentence: She found a small {lump} under her arm and saw a doctor.
translation: Она нашла под мышкой небольшое уплотнение и пошла к врачу.

definition: a thick solid piece of something, or a large part
sentence: He cut a big {chunk} of bread and spread butter on it.
translation: Он отрезал большой ломоть хлеба и намазал его маслом.

definition: a person who takes part in a competition
sentence: Each {contestant} has to sing one song of their choice.
translation: Каждый участник должен спеть одну песню по своему выбору.

definition: to fall or jump suddenly downwards, or to fall sharply in value
sentence: Shares will {plunge} if the bank reports another loss.
translation: Акции резко упадут, если банк снова отчитается об убытках.

definition: to talk or shout angrily for a long time about something
sentence: He began to {rant} about the referee as soon as the match ended.
translation: Как только матч закончился, он начал громко ругать судью.

definition: to produce a model or copy of a real situation to test or train
sentence: The software can {simulate} a flight through a storm.
translation: Программа может имитировать полёт сквозь грозу.

definition: to pause before doing something because you are not sure
sentence: I {hesitated} for a second and then pressed 'buy'.
translation: Я секунду поколебался и нажал «купить».

definition: holding an official position at the present time
sentence: The {incumbent} mayor is running for a third term.
translation: Действующий мэр баллотируется на третий срок.

definition: a machine used in the home, such as a fridge or washing machine
sentence: Every {appliance} in the kitchen is less than a year old.
translation: Каждому прибору на кухне меньше года.

definition: a machine that heats water for a house or building
sentence: The {boiler} broke down and we had no hot water for two days.
translation: Котёл сломался, и у нас два дня не было горячей воды.

definition: to take something quickly and roughly, often by force
sentence: A man tried to {snatch} her phone as she left the station.
translation: Мужчина попытался выхватить у неё телефон, когда она выходила с вокзала.

definition: a flat piece of wood, metal or plastic for carrying food and drinks
sentence: The waiter carried six glasses on one {tray}.
translation: Официант нёс шесть бокалов на одном подносе.

definition: a band of metal or other material that you wear around your arm
sentence: She wears a silver {bracelet} that belonged to her mother.
translation: Она носит серебряный браслет, принадлежавший её матери.

definition: a tax on goods brought into a country, or a list of prices
sentence: The new {tariff} on steel will raise the price of cars.
translation: Новая пошлина на сталь поднимет цены на автомобили.

definition: metal as a very thin sheet, used to cover food
sentence: Wrap the fish in {foil} and bake it for twenty minutes.
translation: Заверни рыбу в фольгу и запекай двадцать минут.

definition: to find the right way to go, especially using maps or instruments
sentence: Sailors once used the stars to {navigate} across the ocean.
translation: Когда-то моряки ориентировались по звёздам, пересекая океан.

definition: a small animal with a long bushy tail that climbs trees and eats nuts
sentence: A {squirrel} buried a nut under the oak tree.
translation: Белка закопала орех под дубом.

definition: one of the tubes that carry blood from the heart around the body
sentence: Fat can block an {artery} and cause a heart attack.
translation: Жир может закупорить артерию и вызвать сердечный приступ.

definition: the person who brings a case against someone in a court
sentence: The {plaintiff} claims the company sold her a faulty car.
translation: Истец утверждает, что компания продала ей неисправную машину.

definition: an open area where goods are sold, or the world of buying and selling
sentence: Farmers sell fruit and cheese in the {marketplace} every Saturday.
translation: Фермеры продают фрукты и сыр на рыночной площади каждую субботу.

definition: a small flying insect that bites people and animals and sucks blood
sentence: A {mosquito} kept me awake all night with its buzzing.
translation: Комар всю ночь не давал мне спать своим жужжанием.

definition: a round object on which thread, wire or film is wound
sentence: He wound the fishing line back onto the {reel}.
translation: Он намотал леску обратно на катушку.

definition: a situation in which a disease spreads quickly to many people
sentence: The flu {epidemic} closed half the schools in the city.
translation: Эпидемия гриппа закрыла половину школ в городе.

definition: to cut or tear something into very thin strips
sentence: Please {shred} these old bank letters before you throw them away.
translation: Пожалуйста, измельчи эти старые письма из банка, прежде чем выбросить.

definition: an instrument shaped like a tube that makes far away things look closer
sentence: Through the {telescope} we could see the rings of Saturn.
translation: В телескоп мы смогли увидеть кольца Сатурна.

definition: a thin wall that divides a room, or the division of a country
sentence: A glass {partition} separates the kitchen from the dining room.
translation: Стеклянная перегородка отделяет кухню от столовой.

definition: an important event in the development of something
sentence: Her first paid job was a {milestone} in her life.
translation: Первая оплачиваемая работа стала важной вехой в её жизни.

definition: a very young cat
sentence: The {kitten} chased a ball of wool across the floor.
translation: Котёнок гонялся за клубком шерсти по полу.

definition: to look at something for a long time, often without noticing anything else
sentence: She would {gaze} out of the window for hours.
translation: Она могла часами смотреть в окно.

definition: to produce many things or ideas, or to lay eggs in water
sentence: The film went on to {spawn} three sequels and a TV series.
translation: Фильм породил три продолжения и телесериал.

definition: a thin flat part on a fish that helps it swim
sentence: A shark's {fin} cut through the water near the boat.
translation: Плавник акулы рассекал воду возле лодки.

definition: a practice of a play, concert or speech before the real performance
sentence: The final {rehearsal} lasted until midnight.
translation: Последняя репетиция длилась до полуночи.

definition: sexually attracted to people of the same sex
sentence: The law gave {homosexual} couples the right to marry.
translation: Закон дал гомосексуальным парам право вступать в брак.

definition: the legal status of belonging to a particular country
sentence: Write your name, age and {nationality} on the form.
translation: Укажи в анкете имя, возраст и гражданство.

definition: a company that sends out TV or radio programmes, or a person who presents them
sentence: The national {broadcaster} will show every match live.
translation: Национальная телекомпания покажет каждый матч в прямом эфире.

definition: the number 80
sentence: My grandfather turned {eighty} and still drives to the shops.
translation: Дедушке исполнилось восемьдесят, и он всё ещё ездит в магазин за рулём.

definition: a long narrow cut in a surface, or a steady enjoyable rhythm in music
sentence: Water runs along the {groove} and drips off the edge.
translation: Вода бежит по канавке и стекает с края.

definition: to fall or sit heavily, or to fail completely
sentence: After the run, he let himself {flop} onto the sofa.
translation: После пробежки он плюхнулся на диван.

definition: to hit hard with a whip or stick, or to tie firmly with rope
sentence: Rain began to {lash} against the windows.
translation: Дождь захлестал по окнам.

definition: a short news report on radio or TV, or a regular printed notice
sentence: The evening news {bulletin} led with the storm.
translation: Вечерний выпуск новостей начался с репортажа о буре.

sentence: The country's debt passed a {trillion} dollars last year.
translation: Долг страны в прошлом году превысил триллион долларов.

definition: to open or untie something, or to cancel the effect of an action
sentence: Press this key to {undo} the last change.
translation: Нажми эту клавишу, чтобы отменить последнее изменение.

definition: free from a duty, tax or rule that others must follow
sentence: Children under five are {exempt} from the ticket charge.
translation: Дети до пяти лет освобождены от платы за билет.

definition: a person who answers questions in a survey, or who defends a legal case
sentence: Every {respondent} was asked how many hours they sleep.
translation: Каждого опрошенного спросили, сколько часов он спит.

definition: to cry, especially from sadness
sentence: She began to {weep} when she read the letter.
translation: Она заплакала, когда прочитала письмо.

definition: to move slowly from side to side, or to influence someone's opinion
sentence: The tall trees {sway} in the wind outside my window.
translation: Высокие деревья качаются на ветру за моим окном.

definition: a very large amount of something, more than enough
sentence: The island has an {abundance} of fresh fruit all year.
translation: На острове круглый год изобилие свежих фруктов.

definition: the right of a region or person to govern themselves and make their own decisions
sentence: The region won greater {autonomy} from the central government.
translation: Регион добился большей автономии от центрального правительства.

definition: relating to the way people or animals act
sentence: The school offers {behavioral} support to children who struggle.
translation: Школа оказывает поведенческую поддержку детям, которым трудно.

definition: a public festival with music, dancing and parades in the street
sentence: The whole town dances in the street during the {carnival}.
translation: Весь город танцует на улицах во время карнавала.

definition: a soft mix of flour and water that is baked into bread
sentence: Leave the {dough} to rise for an hour before baking.
translation: Оставь тесто подниматься на час перед выпечкой.

definition: in danger of no longer existing, used about animals and plants
sentence: The tiger is an {endangered} species in most of Asia.
translation: Тигр — вымирающий вид в большей части Азии.

definition: invented for a story, not real
sentence: The town in the novel is {fictional}, but it feels real.
translation: Город в романе вымышленный, но кажется настоящим.

definition: easily broken or damaged
sentence: Pack the vase carefully, it's very {fragile}.
translation: Упакуй вазу аккуратно, она очень хрупкая.

definition: a very hard grey or pink rock used for building
sentence: The old bridge is built of {granite} and has stood for centuries.
translation: Старый мост построен из гранита и стоит уже века.

definition: a book that gives instructions or information about a subject or job
sentence: The staff {handbook} explains the rules for holidays and sick leave.
translation: В справочнике для сотрудников объясняются правила отпусков и больничных.

definition: strong and able to survive difficult conditions
sentence: These {hardy} plants survive frost and snow without cover.
translation: Эти выносливые растения переживают мороз и снег без укрытия.

definition: a situation that is funny because it is the opposite of what you expected
sentence: The {irony} is that the doctor was the one who got sick.
translation: Ирония в том, что заболел как раз врач.

definition: the judges of a country, considered as one group
sentence: An independent {judiciary} protects citizens from the state.
translation: Независимая судебная власть защищает граждан от государства.

definition: able to cause death
sentence: Even a small dose of the poison can be {lethal}.
translation: Даже малая доза яда может быть смертельной.

definition: full of energy and interest
sentence: The market is {lively} on Saturday mornings, full of music and voices.
translation: Рынок по субботним утрам оживлённый, полон музыки и голосов.

definition: the detailed organisation of moving people, goods and equipment
sentence: The {logistics} of feeding ten thousand runners are enormous.
translation: Организация питания десяти тысяч бегунов — огромная задача.

definition: a tree with five-pointed leaves that turn red in autumn, known for sweet syrup
sentence: A red {maple} leaf is the symbol of Canada.
translation: Красный кленовый лист — символ Канады.

definition: a person's usual way of thinking that shapes how they see things
sentence: Success in sport needs a strong {mindset} as well as a strong body.
translation: Для успеха в спорте нужен сильный настрой, а не только сильное тело.

definition: ideas about what is right and wrong behaviour
sentence: The film raises questions about the {morality} of war.
translation: Фильм поднимает вопросы о нравственности войны.

definition: respected and admired as one of the best
sentence: She won a place at a {prestigious} music school in Vienna.
translation: Она поступила в престижную музыкальную школу в Вене.

definition: the distance from the centre of a circle to its edge
sentence: There is no hospital within a {radius} of fifty kilometres.
translation: В радиусе пятидесяти километров нет ни одной больницы.

definition: the power of a country to govern itself
sentence: The treaty respects the {sovereignty} of every member state.
translation: Договор уважает суверенитет каждого государства-члена.

definition: the light from the sun
sentence: The room gets {sunlight} all afternoon through the big window.
translation: Комната освещена солнцем весь день через большое окно.

definition: representing an idea rather than having a practical effect
sentence: The handshake was {symbolic}: the real talks start next week.
translation: Рукопожатие было символическим, настоящие переговоры начнутся на следующей неделе.

definition: a series of three books, films or plays with the same characters or theme
sentence: The final film of the {trilogy} comes out this winter.
translation: Последний фильм трилогии выходит этой зимой.

definition: used when 'you' (more than one person) is also the object
sentence: Help {yourselves} to coffee and cake, everyone.
translation: Угощайтесь кофе и тортом, все.

definition: a small piece of old cloth used for cleaning
sentence: Wipe the oil off the chain with an old {rag}.
translation: Вытри масло с цепи старой тряпкой.

definition: recently born
sentence: The {newborn} baby slept through the whole party.
translation: Новорождённый проспал всю вечеринку.

definition: to push or drive something forward
sentence: Two large engines {propel} the ship through the ice.
translation: Два больших двигателя толкают корабль сквозь лёд.

definition: a hard silver-white metal, or a five-cent coin in the USA
sentence: The coin is made of {nickel} and copper.
translation: Монета сделана из никеля и меди.

definition: a person who murders an important person, usually for money or politics
sentence: The {assassin} escaped in the crowd after the shooting.
translation: Убийца скрылся в толпе после стрельбы.

definition: unable to speak, or silent and not speaking
sentence: The boy stood {mute} with fear as the dog approached.
translation: Мальчик стоял, онемев от страха, когда собака приближалась.

definition: a bag carried on your back with straps over the shoulders
sentence: She packed a {backpack} and set off for the mountains.
translation: Она собрала рюкзак и отправилась в горы.

definition: a sudden strong wish to do something without thinking
sentence: On an {impulse}, he bought tickets to Lisbon for the weekend.
translation: Поддавшись порыву, он купил билеты в Лиссабон на выходные.

definition: a small book of empty pages for writing notes, or a small laptop
sentence: She writes every new word in a little {notebook}.
translation: Она записывает каждое новое слово в маленький блокнот.

definition: a young person who is developing from a child into an adult
sentence: Every {adolescent} needs more sleep than adults think.
translation: Каждому подростку нужно больше сна, чем думают взрослые.

definition: a helpful piece of advice, or a thing used to point at something
sentence: The coach gave me a few {pointers} on my serve.
translation: Тренер дал мне пару советов насчёт подачи.

definition: to make something firmer so it cannot move, or to make rules stricter
sentence: {Tighten} the screws so the shelf does not wobble.
translation: Подтяни винты, чтобы полка не шаталась.

definition: a long soft seat with a back and arms for two or more people
sentence: The cat has claimed the corner of the {sofa} as its own.
translation: Кот объявил угол дивана своей собственностью.

definition: a set of things sold together, especially a meal of several items
sentence: I ordered the burger {combo} with fries and a drink.
translation: Я заказал комбо с бургером, картошкой фри и напитком.

definition: a person who does not belong to a group, or is not expected to win
sentence: As an {outsider}, she saw problems the team had stopped noticing.
translation: Как человек со стороны, она видела проблемы, которые команда перестала замечать.

definition: a cover for holding papers, or a place on a computer that holds files
sentence: Keep all the receipts in a blue {folder} on my desk.
translation: Держи все чеки в синей папке на моём столе.

definition: the series of events in a book, film or play
sentence: The {storyline} of the film is simple, but the acting is wonderful.
translation: Сюжет фильма прост, но игра актёров прекрасна.

definition: to become bent or twisted out of shape, often because of heat or water
sentence: Wet wood will {warp} as it dries.
translation: Мокрое дерево покоробится, когда высохнет.

definition: a small container of medicine that you swallow, or a small space vehicle
sentence: Take one {capsule} with water after breakfast.
translation: Принимай по одной капсуле после завтрака, запивая водой.

definition: a person who shoots at people from a hidden place, usually from far away
sentence: A {sniper} on the roof controlled the whole square.
translation: Снайпер на крыше контролировал всю площадь.

definition: to make someone do something because of a law or duty, or to help someone
sentence: The new rule will {oblige} every cyclist to wear a helmet.
translation: Новое правило обяжет каждого велосипедиста носить шлем.

definition: to remove or separate one thing from another
sentence: You can {detach} the hood from the jacket in summer.
translation: Летом капюшон можно отстегнуть от куртки.

definition: money or a gift given to someone to make them do something dishonest
sentence: The official refused the {bribe} and called the police.
translation: Чиновник отказался от взятки и вызвал полицию.

definition: a person who uses violence against someone
sentence: The {attacker} ran off when a neighbour shouted.
translation: Нападавший убежал, когда закричал сосед.

definition: a person related to someone who lived long ago
sentence: He is a direct {descendant} of the castle's first owner.
translation: Он прямой потомок первого владельца замка.

definition: a pattern or model that you copy to make something similar
sentence: Use this {template} for every letter the company sends.
translation: Используй этот шаблон для каждого письма, которое отправляет компания.

definition: a platform on the outside of a building, above the ground, where you can stand
sentence: We had breakfast on the {balcony} looking out at the sea.
translation: Мы завтракали на балконе с видом на море.

definition: to bend or tighten a muscle or a part of the body
sentence: {Flex} your arm so the nurse can find the vein.
translation: Согни руку, чтобы медсестра нашла вену.

definition: to move away from the right path or place without meaning to
sentence: Do not {stray} from the marked trail in the fog.
translation: Не сходи с размеченной тропы в тумане.

definition: to get on a ship or plane, or to start something new and important
sentence: Passengers will {embark} at six and the ship sails at seven.
translation: Пассажиры поднимутся на борт в шесть, корабль отплывает в семь.

definition: a person whose job is to cut men's hair
sentence: I go to the same {barber} my father used.
translation: Я хожу к тому же парикмахеру, что и мой отец.

definition: a joke or funny trick, or a piece of cloth put over someone's mouth
sentence: The comedian's best {gag} was about his mother's cooking.
translation: Лучшая шутка комика была про стряпню его матери.

definition: to damage something so badly it cannot work, or to injure someone seriously
sentence: A long strike could {cripple} the whole airline.
translation: Долгая забастовка может парализовать всю авиакомпанию.

definition: to stick firmly to something, or to follow a rule or belief
sentence: All drivers must {adhere} to the speed limit in the tunnel.
translation: Все водители обязаны соблюдать ограничение скорости в туннеле.

definition: a warm knitted piece of clothing for the top half of the body
sentence: She knitted him a red {jumper} for Christmas.
translation: Она связала ему красный джемпер на Рождество.

definition: a British police officer of the lowest rank
sentence: A {constable} stopped the traffic to let the parade pass.
translation: Констебль остановил движение, чтобы пропустить парад.

definition: a thin piece of cloth that covers a woman's face or head
sentence: The bride lifted her {veil} and smiled.
translation: Невеста подняла фату и улыбнулась.

definition: to rise very quickly to a high level
sentence: Ticket prices {soared} the week before the concert.
translation: За неделю до концерта цены на билеты взлетели.

definition: to hold on tightly to someone or something
sentence: The child began to {cling} to her mother's leg.
translation: Ребёнок вцепился в ногу матери.

definition: a table in a church or temple used for religious ceremonies
sentence: The priest placed the candles on the {altar}.
translation: Священник поставил свечи на алтарь.

definition: a British lawyer who gives advice, prepares documents and handles cases
sentence: We asked a {solicitor} to check the contract for the house.
translation: Мы попросили юриста проверить договор на дом.

definition: to laugh quietly in a nervous or silly way
sentence: The girls began to {giggle} every time the teacher turned round.
translation: Девочки хихикали каждый раз, когда учитель поворачивался.

definition: a breakfast food made from grain and eaten with milk, or a grain crop
sentence: The kids eat {cereal} with cold milk every morning.
translation: Дети каждое утро едят хлопья с холодным молоком.

definition: decided by chance or personal choice, not for a good reason
sentence: The limit of three bags seems completely {arbitrary} to me.
translation: Лимит в три сумки кажется мне совершенно произвольным.

definition: able to act or govern without outside control
sentence: The company is testing an {autonomous} bus with no driver.
translation: Компания испытывает беспилотный автобус без водителя.

definition: friendship and loyalty between men, or an organisation of men with a shared aim
sentence: The old soldiers still feel a strong {brotherhood}.
translation: Старые солдаты до сих пор чувствуют крепкое братство.

definition: removing parts of books, films or news that the authorities do not want seen
sentence: Under {censorship}, the newspaper could not print the story.
translation: При цензуре газета не могла напечатать эту историю.

definition: letters or emails sent and received, or a close connection between things
sentence: All {correspondence} with the bank is kept in this folder.
translation: Вся переписка с банком хранится в этой папке.

definition: worth having or doing because it is useful or attractive
sentence: A flat near the park is highly {desirable} and costs more.
translation: Квартира рядом с парком очень востребована и стоит дороже.

definition: showing approval, or good for a purpose
sentence: The report was {favorable}, so the bank approved the loan.
translation: Отчёт был благоприятным, и банк одобрил кредит.

definition: the belief that women should have the same rights and chances as men
sentence: Her mother's {feminism} shaped how she raised her sons.
translation: Феминизм её матери повлиял на то, как она воспитывала сыновей.

definition: the American word for petrol, the fuel used in cars
sentence: The price of {gasoline} rose again this summer.
translation: Цена бензина этим летом снова выросла.

definition: relating to the land, climate and position of a place
sentence: The {geographical} isolation of the island kept its language alive.
translation: Географическая изоляция острова сохранила его язык.

definition: relating to the government
sentence: The museum receives {governmental} funding every year.
translation: Музей ежегодно получает государственное финансирование.

definition: not finished or missing some parts
sentence: The form was {incomplete}, so they sent it back.
translation: Анкета была заполнена не полностью, и её вернули.

definition: the hard white material of elephant tusks
sentence: Selling {ivory} is illegal in most countries today.
translation: Продажа слоновой кости сегодня запрещена в большинстве стран.

definition: continuing for a long time, often too long
sentence: After a {lengthy} delay, the train finally left.
translation: После долгой задержки поезд наконец отправился.

definition: the activity of looking at and understanding written words, or a measurement shown
sentence: Her {reading} improved quickly once she found books she loved.
translation: Её чтение быстро улучшилось, как только она нашла книги, которые полюбила.

definition: a period when a country's economy gets smaller and many people lose jobs
sentence: Thousands of shops closed during the {recession}.
translation: Тысячи магазинов закрылись во время рецессии.

definition: used to introduce the second point in a list
sentence: Firstly, it is too expensive; {secondly}, we do not need it.
translation: Во-первых, это слишком дорого; во-вторых, нам это не нужно.

definition: relating to the bones down the middle of your back
sentence: The fall caused a {spinal} injury that kept him in bed for months.
translation: Падение вызвало травму позвоночника, из-за которой он месяцами лежал в постели.

definition: following one after another without a break
sentence: The team won three {successive} championships.
translation: Команда выиграла три чемпионата подряд.

definition: helping to cure an illness or to make you feel calmer and better
sentence: Gardening has a {therapeutic} effect on many people.
translation: Садоводство оказывает на многих людей целебное действие.

definition: happening at exactly the right moment
sentence: A {timely} warning saved the village from the flood.
translation: Своевременное предупреждение спасло деревню от наводнения.

definition: a heavy radioactive metal used to produce nuclear power
sentence: The mine produced {uranium} for the country's power stations.
translation: Шахта добывала уран для электростанций страны.

definition: a game in which two teams hit a ball over a high net by hand
sentence: We played {volleyball} on the beach until it got dark.
translation: Мы играли в волейбол на пляже, пока не стемнело.

definition: a way of describing something by calling it something else that it is like
sentence: 'Time is money' is a {metaphor} we use every day.
translation: «Время — деньги» — метафора, которую мы используем каждый день.

definition: a feeling of great sadness
sentence: Her face was full of {sorrow} at the funeral.
translation: На похоронах её лицо было полно скорби.

definition: to move or hit something with a quick light movement
sentence: She {flicked} the switch and the room filled with light.
translation: Она щёлкнула выключателем, и комната наполнилась светом.

definition: an animal that feeds its young with milk from the mother's body
sentence: The whale is the largest {mammal} on Earth.
translation: Кит — самое крупное млекопитающее на Земле.

definition: a piece of clothing, used in formal language
sentence: Each {garment} is checked by hand before it leaves the factory.
translation: Каждое изделие проверяют вручную, прежде чем оно покинет фабрику.

definition: a piece of cloth tied around the neck to support an injured arm
sentence: He wore his arm in a {sling} for six weeks after the fall.
translation: После падения он шесть недель носил руку на перевязи.

definition: a stick used to help you walk, or the stem of certain plants
sentence: The old man leaned on his {cane} as he climbed the steps.
translation: Старик опирался на трость, поднимаясь по ступеням.

definition: a person who goes to live in a new area where few people lived before
sentence: The first {settlers} built their homes beside the river.
translation: Первые поселенцы построили свои дома у реки.

definition: a person who does not eat meat or fish
sentence: As a {vegetarian}, she always checks the menu for a meat-free dish.
translation: Будучи вегетарианкой, она всегда ищет в меню блюдо без мяса.

definition: a traditional ceremony, often religious
sentence: The {rite} of passing into adulthood is held every spring.
translation: Обряд перехода во взрослую жизнь проводится каждую весну.

definition: a seat for a rider on a horse or a bicycle
sentence: She tightened the {saddle} before climbing onto the horse.
translation: Она подтянула седло, прежде чем сесть на лошадь.

definition: the process of producing young, or a copy of a painting or object
sentence: The painting on the wall is a {reproduction}; the original is in Paris.
translation: Картина на стене — репродукция, оригинал в Париже.

definition: to make a long low sound of pain or unhappiness, or to complain
sentence: He began to {moan} about the cold the moment we left the house.
translation: Он начал ныть о холоде, едва мы вышли из дома.

definition: something that causes a big change or makes it happen faster
sentence: The strike was the {catalyst} for reform across the industry.
translation: Забастовка стала катализатором реформ во всей отрасли.

definition: a person who competes against the current winner or leader
sentence: The young {challenger} knocked out the champion in round two.
translation: Молодой претендент нокаутировал чемпиона во втором раунде.

definition: a mix of sand, water and cement that holds bricks together
sentence: The bricks are old, but the {mortar} between them is still strong.
translation: Кирпичи старые, но раствор между ними всё ещё крепкий.

definition: a meal eaten outside, often in the countryside
sentence: We had a {picnic} by the lake with sandwiches and fruit.
translation: Мы устроили пикник у озера с бутербродами и фруктами.

definition: a living thing that differs from its kind because its genes have changed
sentence: The {mutant} fly had white eyes instead of red.
translation: У мухи-мутанта глаза были белыми вместо красных.

definition: rubbish such as paper and bottles left lying in public places
sentence: The park was covered in {litter} after the concert.
translation: После концерта парк был усыпан мусором.

definition: the act of taking control of a country or people by force
sentence: The Roman {conquest} of Britain began in the year 43.
translation: Римское завоевание Британии началось в 43 году.

definition: a decision that a planned event or booking will not happen
sentence: A late {cancellation} means you still pay for the room.
translation: При поздней отмене вы всё равно платите за номер.

definition: a small imaginary creature with pointed ears and magic powers
sentence: In the story, an {elf} helps the shoemaker finish his work at night.
translation: В сказке эльф помогает сапожнику заканчивать работу по ночам.

definition: to throw something away because you no longer want it
sentence: Please {discard} any food that is past its date.
translation: Пожалуйста, выбрасывай всю еду с истёкшим сроком.

definition: to make something less long
sentence: Can you {shorten} the speech to five minutes?
translation: Можешь сократить речь до пяти минут?

definition: a judgement about how much something is worth
sentence: The bank's {valuation} of the house was lower than we hoped.
translation: Оценка дома банком оказалась ниже, чем мы надеялись.

definition: to climb quickly using your hands and feet, or to hurry to get something
sentence: We had to {scramble} over the rocks to reach the beach.
translation: Нам пришлось карабкаться по камням, чтобы добраться до пляжа.

definition: a small oven that heats food very quickly using electric waves
sentence: Heat the soup in the {microwave} for two minutes.
translation: Разогрей суп в микроволновке две минуты.

definition: a situation in which people have different opinions, or an argument
sentence: There was a {disagreement} over who should pay for the repairs.
translation: Возникли разногласия о том, кто должен платить за ремонт.

definition: a person who follows and learns from a religious or political leader
sentence: Each {disciple} travelled to a different country to spread the teaching.
translation: Каждый ученик отправился в другую страну распространять учение.

definition: to move to a new place to live or work
sentence: The company will {relocate} its head office to Dublin next year.
translation: В следующем году компания перенесёт головной офис в Дублин.

definition: something wrapped in paper or put in a box to be sent by post
sentence: A {parcel} arrived for you this morning; it is on the table.
translation: Для тебя утром пришла посылка, она на столе.

definition: to praise someone or something publicly
sentence: Critics {acclaim} her new novel as the best of the year.
translation: Критики превозносят её новый роман как лучший в году.

definition: to cry loudly while taking short sharp breaths
sentence: She began to {sob} when she heard that the dog had died.
translation: Она зарыдала, когда услышала, что собака умерла.

definition: a vegetable, especially a cucumber, kept in vinegar or salt water
sentence: He put a {pickle} on top of his burger.
translation: Он положил солёный огурец на свой бургер.

definition: an area whose voters elect one representative to parliament
sentence: The new member of parliament won the {constituency} by just forty votes.
translation: Новый депутат победил в избирательном округе с перевесом всего в сорок голосов.

definition: an earlier decision or event that is used as an example for later ones
sentence: The court's ruling set a {precedent} for similar cases.
translation: Решение суда создало прецедент для похожих дел.

definition: a person who plans towns, events or projects, or a book or app for planning
sentence: The city {planner} wants more trees and fewer car parks.
translation: Градостроитель хочет больше деревьев и меньше парковок.

definition: an insect or small animal that damages crops or food, or an annoying person
sentence: Rats are a serious {pest} in the grain store.
translation: Крысы — серьёзные вредители в зернохранилище.

definition: to make something go in a different direction, or to take someone's attention away
sentence: Police will {divert} traffic around the square during the march.
translation: Полиция направит движение в объезд площади во время шествия.

definition: relating to the air around the Earth, or creating a strong mood
sentence: {Atmospheric} pressure falls before a storm.
translation: Атмосферное давление падает перед грозой.

definition: relating to the heart
sentence: The patient was taken to the {cardiac} unit after the chest pain.
translation: После болей в груди пациента доставили в кардиологическое отделение.

definition: the natural light of the day
sentence: We want to reach the camp while there is still {daylight}.
translation: Мы хотим добраться до лагеря, пока ещё светло.

definition: showing great interest in or excitement about something
sentence: The children were {enthusiastic} about the trip to the zoo.
translation: Дети были в восторге от поездки в зоопарк.

definition: the unhappy feeling of wanting what someone else has
sentence: She looked at her sister's new car with {envy}.
translation: Она с завистью смотрела на новую машину сестры.

definition: treating people unfairly to gain from their work, or making full use of resources
sentence: The report exposed the {exploitation} of workers in the mines.
translation: Отчёт разоблачил эксплуатацию рабочих на шахтах.

definition: the study of how qualities pass from parents to children through genes
sentence: Modern {genetics} can tell you where your ancestors came from.
translation: Современная генетика может сказать, откуда родом ваши предки.

definition: very brave, or needing great effort
sentence: Firefighters made a {heroic} effort to save the old library.
translation: Пожарные приложили героические усилия, чтобы спасти старую библиотеку.

definition: across the whole country
sentence: The programme is shown {nationally} every Sunday evening.
translation: Программу показывают по всей стране каждое воскресенье вечером.

definition: the written records and forms that a job or process requires
sentence: Buying a house involves a lot of {paperwork}.
translation: Покупка дома требует кучи бумажной работы.

definition: quickly and without delay, or exactly at a particular time
sentence: The ambulance arrived {promptly} and took her to hospital.
translation: Скорая приехала быстро и отвезла её в больницу.

definition: honest and really meaning what you say
sentence: Please accept my {sincere} apologies for the delay.
translation: Пожалуйста, примите мои искренние извинения за задержку.

definition: the male cell that joins with a female egg to produce young
sentence: A single {sperm} is enough to fertilise the egg.
translation: Одного сперматозоида достаточно, чтобы оплодотворить яйцеклетку.

definition: at a regular speed, without stopping or changing
sentence: Prices have been rising {steadily} all year.
translation: Цены весь год неуклонно растут.

definition: the combining of separate ideas or substances into one whole
sentence: The book is a {synthesis} of ten years of research.
translation: Книга — синтез десяти лет исследований.

definition: having a good flavour
sentence: The soup was simple but very {tasty}.
translation: Суп был простой, но очень вкусный.

definition: the crime of betraying your own country, for example by helping its enemies
sentence: The spy was tried for {treason} and sent to prison for life.
translation: Шпиона судили за государственную измену и приговорили к пожизненному заключению.

definition: the yellow liquid waste that leaves the body from the bladder
sentence: The doctor asked for a sample of {urine} for the test.
translation: Врач попросил образец мочи для анализа.

definition: a sweet taste from the pod of a tropical plant, used in ice cream
sentence: Add a drop of {vanilla} to the cream before whipping it.
translation: Добавь каплю ванили в сливки, прежде чем взбивать.

definition: a tool or machine for cutting, or a person whose job is cutting
sentence: Use the wire {cutter}, not the kitchen scissors, for the fence.
translation: Для забора используй кусачки, а не кухонные ножницы.

definition: a student or young person working for a short time to gain experience
sentence: The {intern} spent the summer in the newspaper's sports department.
translation: Стажёр провёл лето в спортивном отделе газеты.

definition: to put someone in prison or keep them locked up
sentence: The state can {imprison} a person for up to a year for this offence.
translation: За это нарушение государство может лишить человека свободы на срок до года.

definition: to live in an area and fill it with people
sentence: Farmers began to {populate} the valley two centuries ago.
translation: Фермеры начали заселять долину два века назад.

definition: a large area of land, or a system of connected tubes in the body
sentence: A huge {tract} of forest was sold to a logging company.
translation: Огромный участок леса был продан лесозаготовительной компании.

definition: to travel regularly between home and work
sentence: Thousands of people {commute} into the city by train every day.
translation: Тысячи людей каждый день ездят на работу в город на поезде.

definition: a serious crime such as murder or robbery, in American law
sentence: Stealing a car is a {felony} in most states.
translation: Угон автомобиля в большинстве штатов считается тяжким преступлением.

definition: to start again after stopping
sentence: Save your work and {restart} the computer to finish the update.
translation: Сохрани работу и перезапусти компьютер, чтобы завершить обновление.

definition: a funny copy of a serious book, film or person that exaggerates its features
sentence: The show is a {parody} of television news programmes.
translation: Шоу — пародия на телевизионные новостные программы.

definition: a meeting at which people are given information or instructions
sentence: Pilots attend a weather {briefing} before every flight.
translation: Пилоты посещают брифинг о погоде перед каждым полётом.

definition: a person who travels and works in space
sentence: The {astronaut} spent six months on the space station.
translation: Космонавт провёл шесть месяцев на космической станции.

definition: a person who is very interested in technical or academic subjects and not very social
sentence: He is a self-confessed computer {nerd} who builds his own machines.
translation: Он сам признаёт, что компьютерный ботаник, и собирает свои машины сам.

definition: to walk or travel around with no fixed purpose or direction
sentence: Wild horses {roam} the hills above the village.
translation: Дикие лошади бродят по холмам над деревней.

definition: the player who guards the goal in football and similar games
sentence: The {goalkeeper} saved two penalties in the final.
translation: Вратарь отразил два пенальти в финале.

definition: a system in which people or things are arranged by rank or importance
sentence: In the company's {hierarchy}, a team lead reports to a director.
translation: В иерархии компании руководитель группы подчиняется директору.

definition: to mean or be a sign of something
sentence: A red flag on the beach will {denote} dangerous waves.
translation: Красный флаг на пляже означает опасные волны.

definition: a set of straps that holds a person or animal safely
sentence: Check your {harness} before you start the climb.
translation: Проверь страховочную систему, прежде чем начать подъём.

definition: an official name, title or status given to someone or something
sentence: The park received the {designation} of a World Heritage site.
translation: Парк получил статус объекта Всемирного наследия.

definition: the loss of other people's respect because of bad behaviour, or something shameful
sentence: The minister resigned in {disgrace} after the scandal.
translation: Министр с позором подал в отставку после скандала.

definition: a wide smile
sentence: He had a huge {grin} on his face when he saw the bike.
translation: При виде велосипеда на его лице появилась широченная улыбка.

definition: a person who swims under water with special equipment
sentence: The {diver} found the ring on the bottom of the lake.
translation: Водолаз нашёл кольцо на дне озера.

definition: to live in a place, used of people and animals
sentence: Rare birds {inhabit} the cliffs on the north side of the island.
translation: Редкие птицы населяют скалы на северной стороне острова.

definition: a doctor who treats mental illness
sentence: The {psychiatrist} prescribed medicine and weekly talks.
translation: Психиатр назначил лекарство и еженедельные беседы.

definition: the American word for a path beside a road for people to walk on
sentence: Children drew pictures in chalk on the {sidewalk}.
translation: Дети рисовали мелом на тротуаре.

definition: strong bad feelings towards someone, shown in words or actions
sentence: I don't understand the {hostility} between the two neighbours.
translation: Не понимаю, откуда такая вражда между этими соседями.

definition: to set someone free from prison or control
sentence: The army arrived to {liberate} the city after four years of occupation.
translation: Армия пришла освободить город после четырёх лет оккупации.

definition: to shine with many small flashes of light
sentence: The sea will {sparkle} in the morning sun.
translation: Море будет сверкать в утреннем солнце.

definition: a small wild flower with white petals and a yellow centre
sentence: She picked a {daisy} and put it behind her ear.
translation: Она сорвала ромашку и заложила её за ухо.

definition: to suddenly let a strong force or feeling act freely
sentence: The decision will {unleash} a wave of protest across the country.
translation: Это решение вызовет волну протестов по всей стране.

definition: a holy place connected with a saint or god, or a place that honours someone
sentence: Pilgrims walk for weeks to reach the {shrine} on the mountain.
translation: Паломники неделями идут, чтобы добраться до святилища на горе.

definition: a person who is not brave and avoids danger or pain
sentence: Only a {coward} would leave his friends in the fire.
translation: Только трус бросил бы друзей в огне.

definition: a light or fire on a hill or tower used as a signal or warning
sentence: The {beacon} on the cliff warned ships away from the rocks.
translation: Маяк на утёсе предупреждал корабли о скалах.

definition: the clear liquid part of blood, or a liquid used to protect against disease
sentence: The {serum} contains antibodies taken from recovered patients.
translation: Сыворотка содержит антитела, взятые у выздоровевших пациентов.

definition: a ghost, or something that seems real but is not
sentence: Villagers say a {phantom} walks the old road at night.
translation: Жители деревни говорят, что по старой дороге ночью ходит призрак.

definition: a small flat dry cake that is sweet and crisp
sentence: She dipped a {biscuit} in her tea and it fell apart.
translation: Она макнула печенье в чай, и оно развалилось.

definition: the passage through which air reaches your lungs, or a route for planes
sentence: Keep the patient's {airway} clear until the ambulance comes.
translation: Следи, чтобы дыхательные пути пациента были свободны, пока не приедет скорая.

definition: a person or company that makes beer
sentence: The small {brewer} sells its beer only in the local pubs.
translation: Маленькая пивоварня продаёт пиво только в местных пабах.

definition: an official document showing that you have finished a course of study
sentence: She hung her nursing {diploma} on the wall of her office.
translation: Она повесила диплом медсестры на стену своего кабинета.

definition: to surround something with a wall or fence, or to put something in a letter
sentence: A high wall will {enclose} the garden on three sides.
translation: Высокая стена огородит сад с трёх сторон.

definition: a strong dog with a short neck, a large head and short legs
sentence: The {bulldog} snored loudly under the kitchen table.
translation: Бульдог громко храпел под кухонным столом.

definition: a new printing of a book or picture without changes
sentence: The novel is in its fifth {reprint} since last spring.
translation: Роман выдержал пятое переиздание с прошлой весны.

definition: the act of making something start working
sentence: You will receive a code for the {activation} of your card.
translation: Вы получите код для активации карты.

definition: at a later time, after something else
sentence: We saw the film and went for pizza {afterward}.
translation: Мы посмотрели фильм, а потом пошли есть пиццу.

definition: the sound of people clapping to show they enjoyed something
sentence: The singer bowed as the {applause} filled the hall.
translation: Певица поклонилась, когда аплодисменты заполнили зал.

definition: used to find out what illness or problem someone or something has
sentence: The garage ran a {diagnostic} test to find the fault.
translation: В автосервисе провели диагностический тест, чтобы найти неисправность.

definition: a difference between amounts, especially in pay or prices
sentence: The pay {differential} between men and women at the firm is ten percent.
translation: Разница в оплате мужчин и женщин в фирме составляет десять процентов.

definition: the state of being more powerful or important than others
sentence: The team's {dominance} of the league lasted a decade.
translation: Доминирование команды в лиге длилось десятилетие.

definition: in a way that relates to money and the economy, or without wasting money
sentence: The region is {economically} dependent on tourism.
translation: Регион экономически зависит от туризма.

definition: the amount of water in the air
sentence: The {humidity} today makes thirty degrees feel like forty.
translation: Из-за влажности сегодня тридцать градусов ощущаются как сорок.

definition: pictures, or language that creates pictures in the mind
sentence: The poem is full of {imagery} of winter and silence.
translation: Стихотворение полно образов зимы и тишины.

definition: existing as a natural and permanent part of something
sentence: There is an {inherent} risk in every surgery.
translation: В каждой операции есть неотъемлемый риск.

definition: far from the coast, in the middle of a country
sentence: The {inland} towns are hotter and drier than the coast.
translation: Города в глубине страны жарче и суше, чем на побережье.

definition: the fact of not being guilty, or little experience of the bad things in life
sentence: He spent ten years in prison before his {innocence} was proved.
translation: Он провёл десять лет в тюрьме, прежде чем его невиновность была доказана.

definition: a climbing plant with dark green shiny leaves that grows on walls and trees
sentence: Thick {ivy} covered the whole front of the old house.
translation: Густой плющ покрывал весь фасад старого дома.

definition: animals such as cows, sheep and pigs kept on a farm
sentence: The farmer moved the {livestock} to higher ground before the flood.
translation: Фермер перегнал скот на возвышенность перед наводнением.

definition: a secret criminal organisation, originally from Italy
sentence: The film shows how the {mafia} controlled the city's docks.
translation: Фильм показывает, как мафия контролировала городские доки.

definition: happy and full of fun
sentence: The {merry} crowd sang all the way home from the match.
translation: Весёлая толпа пела всю дорогу домой с матча.

definition: strong pride in your own country, often with the belief that it is the best
sentence: Rising {nationalism} made the trade talks harder.
translation: Растущий национализм осложнил торговые переговоры.

definition: behaving badly, used about children
sentence: The {naughty} puppy chewed my new shoes.
translation: Непослушный щенок изгрыз мои новые туфли.

definition: famous for something bad
sentence: This junction is {notorious} for accidents.
translation: Этот перекрёсток печально известен авариями.

definition: relating to the way a company or activity is planned and arranged
sentence: Her {organizational} skills keep the whole office running.
translation: Её организаторские способности поддерживают работу всего офиса.

definition: completely and at once, or openly without hiding anything
sentence: She refused the offer {outright} and left the room.
translation: Она наотрез отказалась от предложения и вышла из комнаты.

definition: too much; more than is needed or wanted
sentence: The teacher is {overly} strict about handwriting.
translation: Учитель чрезмерно строг к почерку.

definition: a mistake made because you did not notice something, or careful watching of a process
sentence: The missing name was an {oversight}, not an insult.
translation: Пропущенное имя — недосмотр, а не оскорбление.

definition: the act of saying that you will not do or accept something
sentence: His {refusal} to apologise ended the friendship.
translation: Его отказ извиниться положил конец дружбе.

definition: the state of being ill, or the feeling that you are going to vomit
sentence: She missed a week of school because of {sickness}.
translation: Она пропустила неделю школы из-за болезни.

definition: easy to understand or do, or honest and direct
sentence: The instructions are {straightforward}: press start and wait.
translation: Инструкция проста: нажми старт и жди.

definition: showing care for other people, or quiet and thinking deeply
sentence: It was {thoughtful} of you to bring soup when I was ill.
translation: Было заботливо с твоей стороны принести суп, когда я болел.

definition: very violent and cruel, wanting to hurt
sentence: The {vicious} dog attacked a jogger in the park.
translation: Злобная собака напала на бегуна в парке.

definition: a strong clear alcoholic drink, originally from Eastern Europe
sentence: He poured two small glasses of {vodka} for the toast.
translation: Он налил две рюмки водки для тоста.

definition: completely
sentence: The accident was {wholly} the fault of the other driver.
translation: В аварии был целиком виноват другой водитель.

definition: living or lasting for ever
sentence: In the myth the gods are {immortal}, but their children are not.
translation: В мифе боги бессмертны, а их дети — нет.

definition: to make beer, or to make tea or coffee by adding hot water
sentence: Let the tea {brew} for three minutes before you pour it.
translation: Дай чаю завариться три минуты, прежде чем наливать.

definition: an official order or instruction
sentence: A new {directive} bans plastic straws across the whole union.
translation: Новая директива запрещает пластиковые трубочки во всём союзе.

definition: a person who is trying to find or get something
sentence: Every job {seeker} must register with the office first.
translation: Каждый ищущий работу должен сначала зарегистрироваться в бюро.

definition: to experience something unpleasant, such as a cost or a debt, because of your actions
sentence: Late payment will {incur} a fee of twenty euros.
translation: За просрочку платежа взимается сбор в двадцать евро.

definition: to make a sudden small movement that you cannot control
sentence: His eye began to {twitch} from lack of sleep.
translation: У него задёргался глаз от недосыпа.

definition: a small sea creature with a shell and ten legs that is eaten as food
sentence: We ordered grilled {shrimp} with garlic and lemon.
translation: Мы заказали креветки на гриле с чесноком и лимоном.

definition: a glass building used for growing plants that need warmth
sentence: The tomatoes grow faster in the {greenhouse} than outside.
translation: В теплице помидоры растут быстрее, чем на улице.

definition: to break down food in the stomach, or to take in new information
sentence: Rich food takes hours to {digest}.
translation: Жирная пища переваривается часами.

definition: to ignore something or treat it as unimportant
sentence: Please {disregard} my last email; the meeting is still on Tuesday.
translation: Пожалуйста, не обращайте внимания на моё последнее письмо, встреча по-прежнему во вторник.

definition: the state of being easy to hurt, attack or damage
sentence: The report revealed the {vulnerability} of the old bridge to floods.
translation: Отчёт выявил уязвимость старого моста перед наводнениями.

definition: a strong wish to do something you know you should not do
sentence: The {temptation} to check my phone in bed is huge.
translation: Соблазн проверить телефон в кровати огромен.

definition: done on purpose, not by accident
sentence: That was a {deliberate} foul, not an accident.
translation: Это был умышленный фол, а не случайность.

definition: to try very hard to achieve something
sentence: We {strive} to answer every message within a day.
translation: Мы стараемся отвечать на каждое сообщение в течение дня.

definition: to guess about something without knowing all the facts
sentence: Everyone is {speculating} about who will get the job.
translation: Все гадают, кто получит эту должность.

definition: not wanting to do something and slow to agree
sentence: I was {reluctant} to lend him money again.
translation: Мне не хотелось снова одалживать ему деньги.

definition: a situation where you must choose between two difficult options
sentence: I'm in a {dilemma}: a better salary or a shorter commute.
translation: Я перед дилеммой: зарплата выше или дорога короче.

definition: to stay somewhere longer than needed because you do not want to leave
sentence: We {lingered} at the cafe until it closed.
translation: Мы засиделись в кафе до самого закрытия.

definition: to make someone believe something that is not true
sentence: He {deceived} everyone about where the money came from.
translation: Он всех обманул насчёт того, откуда взялись деньги.
